text: The list of applicants and the relevant details of the applications are set out in the appended table.
On different dates, the applicants were taken to police stations.
The applicants were taken to police stations as administrative suspects of offences related to public events.
The applicants were subsequently administratively convicted for participation in different public events in Moscow.
The applicants complained of unlawful detention (deprivation of liberty).
The applicants raised other complaints under the provisions of the Convention.
